name: Dirt Bike Florida Motocross 3D
description:
Hit the jump, land it clean and take the lead. Dirt Bike Florida is a 3D dirt bike racing game with a full motocross career, 26 tracks, supercross stadiums and no account needed. Races work offline, so you can ride your dirt bike on a flight or without signal. The game contains ads, described below.

MOTOCROSS AND SUPERCROSS TRACKS
• 16 outdoor motocross circuits and 8 supercross-style stadiums across desert, forest, highland and red-clay regions
• Eagle Peak Climb: a 1.75 km mountain hill climb with switchbacks and a summit traverse
• Summit Rush: a 1.8 km downhill run with 150 m of descent and fourteen tabletops
• Off-road obstacles: tabletops, doubles, step-ups, whoops, rollers, braking bumps, log crossings, mud bogs and water splashes

MX RACING CAREER
• Eight MX championships of three rounds against seven AI riders
• Ten fictional dirt bikes in Rookie, Club and Pro classes, earned by racing, from your first motorcycle to a pro-class machine
• Earn stars on every track to unlock new bikes and championships
• Tune gearing and suspension in the garage

MASTER THE START
• Nail the holeshot when the gate lights turn green
• Chain smooth landings for a flow boost
• Chase your own best-lap ghost in time trials and earn bronze, silver and gold medals

RIDE YOUR WAY
• Floating touch controls, keyboard or gamepad
• Chase camera or first-person view
• Adjustable stability assist, automatic or manual gears, 30 or 60 fps
• Original 808 soundtrack

OFFLINE DIRT BIKE GAME
Your career, records and replays are saved on your device, and races work without internet, so this motocross game is ready whenever you are.

ADS AND PRIVACY
Ads (banner and interstitial) need a connection, and rewarded ads are optional and unlock cosmetics only. Optional anonymous usage statistics are off unless you enable them. In the EEA, UK and Switzerland you choose your ad privacy settings in a consent dialog and can change them in Settings.

If you like dirt bike games, motocross games, motorcycle racing and off-road bike racing, start your MX career today. Dirt Bike Florida is made by Orlov Games, an independent studio.
